description: Check default._bimi.<domain>: parses the BIMI record, validates the SVG Tiny-PS logo, inspects the VMC chain (expiry, EKU, SCT, issuer-accepted, SAN match, logotype hash), and verifies the DMARC prerequisite (p=quarantine/reject at pct=100 with no sp=none — the RFC 7489 reading Gmail and Apple Mail evaluate today). DMARCbis (RFC 9989) aware: t= is parsed into analysis.dmarc.t, t=y emits TESTING_MODE (warn under p=quarantine — bis receivers read it as none; info under p=reject), and a present pct= emits DEPRECATED_TAG (removed by RFC 9989 Appendix A.6, advisory only). Returns grade (A-F), structured findings, and an `analysis` block (logo/vmc/dmarc/provider_matrix). Read-only.

domain.description: Apex domain to inspect, e.g. "google.com". No scheme, no path.

name: check_bimi

analysis.description: Tool-specific detail; its fields are typed in the resource mcp://tamingdns/resources/analysis/<tool name>.
